acceptanceCriteria: Frozen code2test retrieves the c7ea7d6f gold test without lowering other frozen suites beyond their tolerance, or a recorded evaluation shows why the documentation share must win.
body: Residual from the recall-1021s lane (PR #1515, V1-2288). The frozen code2test re-baseline differs from 242fde6 only on diffusers c7ea7d6f: its gold test is displaced by documentation rows that first appear at #639 (merge 76f7f2ac4, the V1-0859 documentation share). The paired-test omission is now disclosed (TCP-V0-161 coverage.omitted_pairs) but the test is still lost. Expected: a paired test of a changed source file outranks budget-share documentation rows, or the share yields to it. Confirmed by bisection in the lane report.
title: code2test: V1-0859 documentation share pushes the diffusers c7ea7d6f gold test out of the context budget
